patch_description: The baseline assigns every partition the same single Dijkstra path, which both wastes cheaper parallel routes and concentrates load on a single network link. A better broadcast strategy: for each destination, compute the k-shortest simple paths (by cost). Distribute partitions across these candidate paths so that cheaper paths serve more partitions while more expensive alternates absorb the remaining partitions. This exploits multi-network topologies (parallel paths), reduces redundant transfer volume on costly links, and balances load. We also cache candidate paths per destination to avoid recomputation overhead, and gracefully fall back to a single path when fewer alternatives exist.
